requirements: Expand and maintain the telemetry and integrations XDR depends on: first-party Elastic data plus third-party EDR, cloud, identity, and network sources that let the product correlate across a real environment
Contribute to Elastic's exposure and vulnerability management work, including prioritization based on exploitability and reachability rather than raw CVSS, and remediation workflow
Ensure your capabilities work across Elastic's deployment models, from cloud to on-premises to air-gapped, so they hold up in regulated and disconnected environments
Maintain well-developed awareness of the competitive landscape and GTM strategies
Telemetry and Integration Breadth: Comfort building or owning products that rely on heterogeneous third-party data, with a awareness that XDR depends on ingestion breadth and healthy integrations

Customer-Facing Confidence: You are comfortable representing product to security customers, including senior stakeholders, and can hold both the practitioner and the leadership view in the same conversation

title: Head of Product - Business Banking
city: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
summary: Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance.
requirements: Own the P&L, strategy, and product offering: accounts, user experience, payments, new rails, and agents
Build AI - and data-driven user experiences at scale better than the alternatives
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set an operating cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Deepen the core account and take new products 0-1 to scale: optimize what businesses run on, and invest in new rails, capabilities, and agents so customers can focus on building their companies
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the banking ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, sales, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy

title: Senior Manager, Security Ops & Prod Security
summary: Calendly takes the work out of scheduling, giving our customers more time to focus on what truly matters.
requirements: A day in the life of a Senior Manager, Product Security & Security Operations at Calendly
Lead the Product Security and Security Operations teams, developing talent and holding the teams accountable for measurable outcomes
Build strong partnerships across Security and with key cross-functional teams to align on risk, response, and remediation
Communicate priorities, risk tradeoffs, and program performance to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
Scale product security capabilities, including threat modeling, application security testing, vulnerability management, and developer enablement
Lead detection engineering, incident response, threat intelligence, monitoring, and threat hunting capabilities

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
summary: Architecture & Development: Play a critical role in the design, architecture, and implementation of scalable, robust software solutions across the stack.

End-to-End Engineering: Prototype and develop web applications with complex interaction patterns, flexible components, and efficient backend systems using Python, TypeScript/React, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake
API & Backend Ownership: Build and maintain server-side applications, APIs, and database management systems that power our platform
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, Customer Success, and Sales to deliver features that solve meaningful customer problems
Technical Leadership: Lead projects, guide technical direction, and act as a systems design expert for complex initiatives
5+ years of full-stack engineering experience, with strong experience in Python, TypeScript/React, and PostgreSQL

title: Solutions Engineer
summary: Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurateurs adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses that they love.
requirements: Become a subject matter expert on Toast products with complete knowledge of the technologies, application software, and integrated partners, and future product roadmap
Work closely with Sales Enablement regionally to provide training and product expertise
Must have ability to work closely with Product Management, Sales Enablement, and Marketing teams
Use restaurant industry knowledge / experience to consult with prospects on how Toast can help them outperform their peers

Presentation Skills: Executive presence and the ability to articulate complex products and ideas with clarity, and handle complex customer communications fluently while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction
Strong understanding of APIs (coding skills not required)

title: Manager, Customer Success (Spanish Speaking)
summary: At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table.
requirements: Balance autonomy with effective communication upwards
Motivate CSMs to foster customer relationships that build trust and achieve consistent revenue growth
Focus on talent attraction, retention, and development to create high-performance teams
Experienced in Customer Success or Account Management, with 6+ years of experience preferred and at least 3 years in the SaaS space
3+ years of experience leading a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers
Familiar with the B2B tech or subscription-based software space

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring.
requirements: Safety AI builds the ML and computer vision systems behind Samsara's AI dash cameras which enable real-time driver alerts, risk signals, and coaching insights running on millions of edge devices and the cloud
This role owns what happens after training: building the resilient, low-latency ML backend systems that turn static model artifacts into high-throughput, cloud-scale safety features
This is ML engineering where the stakes are real: rare, high-consequence events, millions of vehicles, and a product where "it works" means someone got home safely. Kindly refer to this video
Set a high bar for reliability: rigorous evaluation, measurable rollout health, and systems that degrade predictably rather than silently
Design Production ML APIs: Architect and maintain reliable, low-latency APIs to integrate Safety AI model outputs directly into cloud applications
Build Data Flywheels: Construct scalable pipelines to power continuous model iteration, backtesting, shadow and online evaluation, enabling fast and safe deployments

title: Senior Release Engineer
city: Boston, Massachusetts, United States; Las Vegas, Nevada, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States; Remote U.S.
summary: Release Gating & Validation: Collaborate with the Release team to implement and enforce "shift-left" quality gates, ensuring that only stable, well-validated code reaches release branches.
requirements: Branching & Governance: Assist in executing the organization’s release strategy (e.g., maintaining clean branching models) to ensure release isolation and stability

Data-Driven Optimization: Contribute to the visibility of release metrics, identifying bottlenecks in the build process and proposing data-backed solutions to improve release team and developer velocity
Automation & Tooling: Write and maintain automation scripts to enforce release quality, minimize manual overhead, and manage build compatibility across diverse autonomy stacks
Engineering Foundation: BS or MS in Engineering or equivalent knowledge and work experience
Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Git, Python; advanced experience with CI/CD infrastructure (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins)
Domain Knowledge: Experience in the autonomous driving sector, robotics, or complex software release environments

title: Staff/Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Product Engineering
summary: At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
requirements: Bring AI to where our customers already work: build Harvey across every surface — web, desktop, mobile, and embedded experiences (Google Docs, MS Word, Outlook, and Slack), and API
Lead large, high-priority projects that span multiple teams, and define the technical bets we make over the next several quarters

Ship across the stack — React and TypeScript alongside Python and Postgres — architecting intuitive UX and robust APIs for streaming results, long-running processes, and complex tool-calling workflows
Mentor senior and staff engineers, and raise the bar for how the whole org builds
Experience building scalable, extensible systems that support multiple product lines
